extraTable: {"description":"Unsecured consumer loan eligibility, with the limits of the retail_credit parameter set","effectiveFrom":"2027-06-01","hitPolicy":"FIRST","id":"loan_eligibility","inputs":{"amount":"decimal","applicant":{"age":"int","blacklisted":"bool","monthlyDebt":"decimal","monthlyIncome":"decimal","segment":"string"}},"let":{"dti":"applicant.monthlyDebt / applicant.monthlyIncome","maxAmount":"applicant.monthlyIncome * params.incomeMultiple"},"outputs":{"decision":"string","limit":"decimal"},"params":{"set":"retail_credit","values":{"blockedSegments":["string"],"incomeMultiple":"int","maxDti":"decimal","minAge":"int"}},"rules":[{"description":"Applicants must be of the minimum age","id":"R1","reasonCode":"UNDERAGE","then":{"decision":"'REJECT'"},"when":"applicant.age < params.minAge"},{"id":"R2","reasonCode":"BLACKLISTED","then":{"decision":"'REJECT'"},"when":"applicant.blacklisted"},{"description":"Segments the policy does not lend to","id":"R3","reasonCode":"SEGMENT_BLOCKED","then":{"decision":"'REJECT'"},"when":"applicant.segment in params.blockedSegments"},{"description":"Debt-to-income above the policy limit","id":"R4","reasonCode":"DTI_HIGH","then":{"decision":"'REJECT'"},"when":"dti > params.maxDti"},{"description":"Up to the policy's multiple of monthly income, rounded down to the nearest million","id":"R5","then":{"decision":"'APPROVE'","limit":"(maxAmount / 1000000).round(0, 'FLOOR') * 1000000"},"when":"amount <= maxAmount"},{"id":"R6","reasonCode":"AMOUNT_ABOVE_LIMIT","then":{"decision":"'REVIEW'"},"when":"true"}],"version":"5"}
